Name: Rabbit Mount
Author: elithebookworm
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/p9qmCJm.gif[/img]

[b][u][size=5]How to install:[/size][/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.
[*]Generate the [code]config.json[/code] file in the mod folder by running the game, then closing it.
[*]Open the newly generated [code]config.json[/code] file on a text editor (such as Notepad) and change the option to what breed you want for your rabbit mount. Check the [code]References[/code] folder so you can see what each breed looks like.
[*]Run the game through SMAPI and enjoy!
[/list]
[b]Optional:[/b] I've added an optional folder that lets you use all 10 skins with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url]﻿. If you're using Adopt 'n' Skin, you don't need to download the main file. You just need to download the optional [code]Rabbit Skins[/code] file. To use, simply extract the [code]skins[/code] file into [code]AdoptSkin/assets[/code] and merge.

[u][b]To uninstall[/b][/u], ﻿delete the mod from your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.

[b][u][size=5]Changing the Breed:[/size][/u][/b]
Once the config.json file has been generated, open it on Notepad. You'll see these lines of text:
[code]{
﻿"Rabbit": "White"
}[/code]
It is set to White by default. To change the breed, simply change the name to a breed that you prefer. The names can be seen in the reference image in the [code]References[/code] folder. 
For example, if you want your rabbit mount to look like a Silver Fox rabbit, simply change [code]"White"[/code] into [code]"SilverFox"[/code].

[b][color=#ff7700]CAUTION![/color][/b] It is unfortunate but hats don't work with the rabbit mount. They don't align with the rabbit sprites.
